def make_counter():
    n = 0
    def bump():
        nonlocal n
        n = n + 1
        return n
    return bump

def make_pair():
    n = 0
    def bump():
        nonlocal n
        n = n + 1
        return n
    def peek():
        return n
    return bump, peek
